meta.transitMethod: Google Maps Directions, travelmode=transit, 'Leave now', captured 2026-11-25 between 17:14 and 17:31 America/New_York, origin = hotel name exactly as on Booking.com, destination = representative restaurant/venue name. Each row records the FASTEST itinerary Google returned at capture (not the pre-selected default, which is sometimes slower). Times are door-to-door incl. walking. Live service estimates, not timetables; re-run the linked URL before committing to a reservation.
meta.fareNote: Every subway/bus itinerary showed $3.00 (OMNY/MetroCard single ride). NYC Ferry legs showed $4.50. Fares verified only as displayed in the directions panel.
meta.priceMethod: Booking.com public search, Manhattan, 2 adults, 1 room, USD, 4–5 star filter, sorted price (lowest first). Each figure is the cheapest qualifying room's displayed stay total for that exact date window, captured on 2026-11-25. Displayed totals exclude taxes/fees unless the line says 'before taxes'. Re-verify before booking.

bookingCaution.finding: Booking.com currently applies a property-declared 'Black Friday Deal' (valid on select stays 2026-11-19 → 2027-12-31) at several hotels. That is a dated promotional discount, not a forecast. No official source states the cheapest future booking date for these specific hotels; therefore no 'best time to book' date is asserted.
bookingCaution.what_we_can_say: For the preferred window, today's displayed 7-night total (e.g., $943 pre-tax king room at DoubleTree Chelsea) reflects a live 30% promotion. Booking.com's own price-comparison/free-cancellation terms allow holding a cancellable rate now and re-checking later.
bookingCaution.how_to_verify: Re-run the same saved Booking.com search weekly and log the total; the site's Booking Strategy page lists the exact saved URLs.

meta.activityTransitCaveat: Only 4 of the 10 activity legs in the source session carried both minutes and a routing URL. The other 6 were notes without a captured route and are not presented as measured values.

findings.finding: All 25 measured hotel→Michelin-cluster legs are ≤37 minutes; the one-hour rule does not separate the tested hotels.
Eurostars Wall Street → Crown Shy is a 3-minute walk; The Frederick → Jungsik is 5 minutes.

No official source names a future date when rates will be lowest. Hold a cancellable rate and re-run saved searches weekly (F23).
